panels.general_description: Brain perfusion image grids with quantitative volume and ratio readouts.
panels.detailed_description: Lower-right D is a black perfusion dashboard with two grids of small axial brain slices. The left grid is headed CBF and has magenta overlays; the right is headed Tmax and has green overlays. Small A, R and L orientation letters and the RAPID label are visible. Printed readouts include CBF<30%: 40 ml, Tmax>6.0s: 142 ml, Mismatch volume: 102 ml and Mismatch ratio: 3.5. The D label is below the frame.
